GAP-001.conversion: Convert array to map keyed by node.id. Must also provide rootNodeIds array.

GAP-002.proof_field: No rootNodeIds — implicit from building with parentId=null
GAP-002.conversion: Find all nodes with parentId=null, add their IDs to rootNodeIds array.

GAP-003.pascal_field: start: [x, y], end: [x, y] — 2D tuples at node level
GAP-003.conversion: Map start_point_2d → start, end_point_2d → end. Wall position from BaseNode becomes [0,0,0] (child of level).

GAP-004.proof_field: Custom children arrays on building, level
GAP-004.pascal_field: parentId on every node + children arrays on building/level/wall
GAP-004.conversion: Set parentId=levelId on walls/slab/doors/windows. Keep children arrays for building→level, level→children.

GAP-005.proof_field: Global 3D position [x, sill_height, z] in level coordinates
GAP-005.conversion: Convert global→local: project global point onto wall line. u = distance from wall start. v = sill height. w = 0 (centered on wall).

GAP-006.proof_field: metadata.vision5d with project_id, source_sha256, dxf_handles, etc.
GAP-006.conversion: No conversion needed — z.json() accepts arbitrary JSON.

GAP-007.pascal_field: polygon: z.array(z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()])) — described as [x, z] in docs
GAP-007.conversion: Map: proof's (x,y) → Pascal's (x, z). Y-axis in proof = Z-axis (north) in Pascal level coords.

GAP-009.proof_field: No site node — building is root
GAP-009.pascal_field: SiteNode is typically root with buildings as children
GAP-009.conversion: Create a site node, set building.parentId = site.id, rootNodeIds = ['site_...'].

GAP-010.proof_field: Custom IDs: wall_v5d_000, door_v5d_000, window_v5d_000, building_v5d001
GAP-010.conversion: Regenerate IDs using Pascal's nanoid format OR keep Vision 5D IDs. Both pass Zod validation (z.string()).
